messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Is geom='jitter' and position='jitter' the same?
parts:
hi

geom_jitter is a sub class of geom_point with defautls
stats="identity" and position="jitter", so,
geom_jitter() is equivalent to geom_point(stat="identity", position="jitter")
